title.en: Ossan wa Uzeeeen da yo! tte Guild kara Tsuihou Shita Kuse ni, Go kara Fukki Yousei wo Dasarete mo Osoi. Saikou no Nakama to Deatta Ore wa Kocchi de Saikyou wo Mezasu!
Saiteihen no Ossan Boukensha. Guild wo Tsuihou Sareru Tokoro de Ima made no Doryoku ga Mukuware, Kyuu ni Saikyou Skill "Mujouken Shouri" wo Eru

E, Tamer wa Tsukaenai tte Party kara Tsuihou shita yo ne? ~ Jitsu wa Sekai Yuiitsu no "Elemental Master" dato Hanmei shita Totan ni Tenohira wo Kaesaretemo Osoi. Seirei no Oujosama ni Mechakucha Dekiai sare nagara, Boku wa My Pace ni Saikyou wo Mezasu node
Zen Jidou Mahou [Auto Magic] no Cost Performance Musou "Seichou Speed ga Chou Osoi" to Tsuihou Sareta ga, Houchishite mo Keikenchi ga Atsumaru Mitai Desu
Tsuihou Sareta S-kyuu Kanteishi wa Saikyou no Guild wo Tsukuru
Kashita Maryoku wa "Ribobarai" de Kyousei Choushuu ~Youzumi to Party Tsuihousareta Ore wa, Kawaii Support Yousei to Issho ni Toritateta Maryoku wo Unyou shite Saikyou wo Mezasu.~
Ryuu ni Sodaterareta Saikyou ~Subete wo Kiwameta Shounen wa Ningenkai wo Musou suru~
Tsuihou Bokensha no Yarinaoshi ~Yousei-kai de Kitae Naoshite Jibun no Ibasho wo Tsukuru~
Otasuke Chara ni Tensei Shita no de, Game Chishiki de Musou Suru ~Unmei wo Nejifusete, Saikyou wo Mezasou to Omoimasu~
Boukensha Party wo Tsuihou sareta Kaifukushi Shoujo wo Hirotte Ikusei Shitara Masaka no Saikyou Shokugyou ni Tenshoku!? Omake ni Kanojo no Yousu ga nani yara Okashikute...
Kono Boukensha, Jinruishi Saikyou desu - Hazura Skill "Kantei" ga "Keishou" ni Kakusei shita no de, Amata no Eiyuu-tachi no Chikara wo Uketsugi Musou suru
Mushoku no Saikyou Kenja ~Job ga Erarezu Tsuihou Saretaga, Game no Chishiki de Isekai Saikyou~
Tsuihou Sareta Ossan Kajishi, Nazeka Densetsu no Daimyouko ni Naru ~Mukashi Omocha no Buki o Tsukutteageta Kodomotachi ga Zenin Eiyuu ni Natteita~
The Demon Lord's Daughter and the Strongest Man
Hitodasuke wo Shitara Party wo Tsuihousareta Otoko wa, Unique Skill "Otasuke Man" de Nariagaru.
Tsuihou Sareta Tanyashi wa Cheat Skill de Densetsu o Tsukuri Makuru ~Konyakusha ni Mise o Oidasareta kedo, Kimama ni Mono Tsukutteirareru Ima no Hou ga Shiawase Desu~
Seijo, Yuusha Party Kara Kaikosareta node Guild wo Tsukuttara at Home na Saikyou Guild ni Sodachimashita
